telemetry.description: Set to false to stop smartcloud sending anonymous telemetry (hashed usage events, logs, traces, metrics and errors) to PostHog. On by default; turning it off is discouraged, because telemetry is how problems are found and fixed. The telemetry page of the documentation lists what is and is not collected.

SmartcloudConfig.description: Declarative repository automation: labels, conventions and policy.
SmartcloudConfig.title: smartcloud configuration

ExtendsEntry.description: A preset to extend, as owner/repo/path@ref. The ref is optional.

Subjects.description: The subjects a rule applies to. Omitted means pull requests and issues.

creatorMatches.description: The author's login matches a pattern.

branchMatches.description: The pull request's head branch matches a pattern.

baseBranchMatches.description: The pull request's base branch, the one it merges into, matches a pattern.

items.description: owner, member, collaborator (an outside collaborator), contributor, firstTimeContributor (includes first-timers), firstTimer, mannequin, none or bot.

condition.description: The associations that pass; any one is enough.

authorAssociation.description: The author's association with the repository is one of these, or the author is a bot when bot is listed.

hasAssignee.description: Someone is assigned, or nobody is when false.

assigneeMatches.description: An assignee's login matches a pattern.

hasMilestone.description: The subject is in a milestone, or in none when false.

milestoneMatches.description: The title of the subject's milestone matches a pattern.

items.description: A Linear team key, such as SMC.

keys.description: The Linear team keys that count; any key when omitted.

linksIssue.description: The pull request closes an issue in its description, or carries a Linear key in its branch or title; links none when false.

isOpen.description: The subject is open, or closed when false.

isLocked.description: The conversation is locked, or unlocked when false.

isDraft.description: The pull request is a draft, or ready when false.

pendingReview.description: Requested reviewers have not reviewed yet.

requestedChanges.description: A reviewer's latest review requests changes.

reviewerMatches.description: A requested reviewer's login or team slug, or a reviewer's login, matches a pattern.

commitsSignedOff.description: Every non-merge commit has a Signed-off-by trailer matching its author email.

commitsVerified.description: Every commit has a GPG, SSH or S/MIME signature that GitHub verified.

hasConflict.description: The pull request conflicts with its base branch, or does not when false. Unknown mergeability counts as not conflicting.

items.description: A check run name or commit status context, matched exactly.
items.title: nonEmptyString

checks.description: Check run names or commit status contexts, matched exactly.

checksPass.description: Every named check succeeded, or at least one has not when false. A check that has not reported yet has not succeeded.

check.description: A check run name or commit status context, matched exactly.
check.title: nonEmptyString

condition.description: success, failure or pending; a check that has not reported yet is pending.

checkStatus.description: The named check is in this state. A check that has not reported yet is pending.

hasLabel.description: The subject has the label, or lacks it when false.

isStale.description: No activity for at least this many days.

isAbandoned.description: Carries the stale label and has had no activity for at least this many days.

filesMatch.description: At least one changed file matches a glob.

condition.description: A CODEOWNERS owner: @org/team, @user or an email.

codeownersTouched.description: At least one changed file is owned by this owner in CODEOWNERS.

changesSize.description: Lines added plus deleted are at least min and below max.

lockfileChanged.description: A dependency lockfile changed, or none did when false.

fileCount.description: The number of changed files is at least min and below max.

binaryFilesAdded.description: The pull request adds a binary file, or none when false.

allowPending.description: Count approvals while other requested reviewers are still pending (default false).

isApproved.description: No reviewer is requesting changes, at least this many approved, and none are pending unless allowPending is set.

scope.description: Whether every commit (all) or at least one commit (any) must match.
Whether every commit (all) or at least one commit (any) must match.

hasTrailer.description: Commits carry the trailer, with a value matching the pattern when one is given.

bots.description: Also match comments by bot accounts (default false).

commentMatches.description: At least one comment matches a pattern; comments by bots count only when bots is set.

reaction.description: The reaction to count: +1, -1, laugh, hooray, confused, heart, rocket or eyes. Every reaction when omitted.

reactionCount.description: The number of reactions (of one kind, when reaction is set) is at least min and below max.

createdBefore.description: The subject was created at least this many days ago, or before this ISO 8601 date.

Instant.description: An ISO 8601 date (2026-01-31, midnight UTC) or date and time with an offset (2026-01-31T09:00:00Z).

days.description: The days the window opens on; every day when omitted.

from.description: When the window opens, as HH:MM (inclusive); midnight when omitted.

to.description: When the window closes, as HH:MM (exclusive); midnight when omitted.

timeWindow.description: Now is inside the weekly window of days and hours, or outside it when false.

Weekday.description: A day of the week: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat or sun.

TimeZone.description: An IANA time zone name, such as Europe/London, or UTC.

condition.description: The update types that pass; any one is enough.

bots.description: More logins that open dependency updates, such as a self-hosted Renovate app; dependabot[bot] and renovate[bot] always count.

dependencyUpdateType.description: A Dependabot or Renovate pull request's largest version change is one of these: patch, minor or major.

UpdateType.description: A version update: patch, minor or major.

$only.description: Exactly this many of the groups pass.

s.description: The fewest lines added plus deleted that make a pull request Size: S. Defaults to 10.
s.title: positive

m.description: The fewest lines added plus deleted that make a pull request Size: M. Defaults to 100.
m.title: positive

l.description: The fewest lines added plus deleted that make a pull request Size: L. Defaults to 500.
l.title: positive

xl.description: The fewest lines added plus deleted that make a pull request Size: XL. Defaults to 1000.
xl.title: positive

thresholds.description: The first line count of each size above XS. Sizes left out keep their defaults; the thresholds must rise from s to xl.

SizeLabels.description: Built-in Size: XS to Size: XL labels, applied to pull requests by lines added plus deleted. Thresholds are the first line count of each size.

ignore.description: Checks that do not count towards the aggregate, as patterns matched against each check run name or status context, for example ^codecov/.

expect.description: Checks that must appear on the head commit and pass, as patterns matched against each check run name or status context, for example ^check$. One that has not appeared by the timeout fails the aggregate, so a deleted or renamed CI job cannot pass unnoticed.

timeout.description: Minutes to wait for the other checks to finish before failing, from 1 to 360 (the longest an Actions job may run). Defaults to 60.
timeout.title: between(1, 360)

Required.description: One aggregate check that passes only when every other check on the pull request has passed, so a ruleset requires that one check instead of a list of names.

active.description: Freeze merges now, until this is set back to false. Off by default.

reason.description: Why merges are frozen while active is true.

windows.description: Scheduled freezes, by key: dated (start and end) or recurring (from and to, every day or every week).

labels.description: Pull requests with any of these labels may merge during a freeze.

Freeze.description: A merge freeze, manual or scheduled: while one is in effect the freeze check fails on open pull requests and merge queue entries fail.

reason.description: Why merges are frozen, shown on the check and in the report.

from.description: HH:MM for a time every day, or a three-letter day and HH:MM, such as Fri 16:00, for a time every week.

to.description: HH:MM for a time every day, or a three-letter day and HH:MM, such as Fri 16:00, for a time every week.

reason.description: Why merges are frozen, shown on the check and in the report.

names.description: The accepted forms of branch name, by key, so presets and repositories merge them. A head branch passes when it matches any of them.

level.description: error fails the check; warning only reports. Defaults to error.

message.description: Shown instead of the list of accepted names.

branches.description: Head branches matching any of these patterns are not checked, such as ^dependabot/.

authors.description: Pull requests opened by these logins are not checked, such as renovate[bot].

Branches.description: A branch naming policy: the head branch of every pull request must match one of the accepted names.

preset.description: prefixed: <prefix>/<description>, such as ann/fix-typo or feat/labels. issueKey: an issue key such as SMC-12 anywhere in the name, between separators.

prefixes.description: The prefixes the prefixed preset accepts, such as feat and fix, or the names of people. Any prefix when left out.

items.description: An issue tracker key, such as SMC. Matched in any case, so smc-12 counts.

keys.description: The issue tracker keys the issueKey preset accepts, such as SMC. Any key when left out.

BranchName.description: One accepted form of branch name: a preset, a pattern, or both, when the name must meet both.

path.description: Where the file lives, one of the locations GitHub reads. By default, the first that exists, or .github/CODEOWNERS.

rules.description: Rules to generate, by key, so presets and repositories merge them. They are written in order, and the last matching rule wins. A key must not be a whole number such as 2, which would be moved first.

check.description: Check pull requests that change CODEOWNERS. On by default.

level.description: error fails the check; warning only reports. Defaults to error.

branch.description: The branch generated changes are proposed from. Defaults to smartcloud/codeowners.
branch.title: nonEmptyString

CodeOwners.description: CODEOWNERS: check the file on pull requests that change it, and generate a block of it from rules in the config.

paths.description: The path patterns these owners own, each written as its own CODEOWNERS line.

owners.description: The owners of the paths. An empty list leaves them without an owner, overriding an earlier rule.

comment.description: A comment written above the lines, such as Documentation.

CodeOwnersRule.description: Paths and their owners, written to the generated block of CODEOWNERS.

CodeOwnersPath.description: A path pattern such as *.md, /docs/ or apps/**/*.ts. GitHub does not support ! or [ ] in CODEOWNERS patterns; write a space as \ followed by a space, as in docs/My\ Files/.

CodeOwner.description: A user as @login, a team as @org/team, or an email address.

Trimmed.description: a string with no leading or trailing whitespace
Trimmed.title: trimmed

BackportPrefix.description: The start of a backport label, such as `backport `; the rest of the label is the branch.
BackportPrefix.title: Backport label prefix

requiredApprovals.description: a number less than or equal to 10
requiredApprovals.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(10)

SecretName.description: The name of the environment variable holding the secret.

overrides.description: Per-command changes to who may use it, by command name.

snoozeDays.description: Days /stale-snooze keeps an item from being marked stale when no number is given; 30 by default.
snoozeDays.title: between(1, 365)

mergeMethod.description: How /merge and /automerge merge when no method is given; squash by default.

labelPrefix.description: Labels that ask for a backport on merge are this prefix and the target branch; "backport " by default.
labelPrefix.title: nonEmptyString

branchPrefix.description: Backport branches start with this; "backport/" by default.
branchPrefix.title: nonEmptyString

reactions.description: React to each command comment with 👍 or 😕. On by default.

enabled.description: Set to false to ignore the command. On by default.

permission.description: The lowest repository role that may use the command. Each command has its own default.

author.description: Whether the issue's or pull request's author may use the command on their own item whatever their role. Each command has its own default.
